title: Great is the Lord
lyrics: [G]Great is the Father, great is the [D/F#]Son
[Em7]Great is the Spirit, great is the Three In [C]One
[G]Great in His mercy, great in His [D/F#]love
[Em7]Great in His power, great in His fullness [C]above
Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise
The heavens display in extravagant ways
Your glory, Your majesty, Your splendour
